title: ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol
content:
SOP: ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol (SOP-ICU-001)
DEPARTMENT: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
VERSION: 2.5
ROLES: doctor, nurse, case_management
PURPOSE: Prioritize hemodynamic beds and safe step-down to wards.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol in full compliance with Intensive Care Unit (ICU) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol in full compliance with Intensive Care Unit (ICU) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol in full compliance with Intensive Care Unit (ICU) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol in full compliance with Intensive Care Unit (ICU) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol in full compliance with Intensive Care Unit (ICU) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol in full compliance with Intensive Care Unit (ICU) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Intensive Care Unit (ICU).
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-ICU-001 ICU Clinical Admission and Step-Down Protocol v2.5, Section 4
